name: PROMIS Global Health-10
description: 10-item questionnaire covering physical, mental, and social health. Scores reported as T-scores calibrated to 2000 US Census norms (mean=50, SD=10).
shirleySays: SEM ~3.7 pts (Physical); ~3.5 pts (Mental). MCID: ~3–5 T-score points. ICC 0.89–0.92. Calibrated to 2000 US Census norms. 10 items covering physical, mental, and social health. Most versatile single cross-domain screen.

scoring.range: Physical Health T-score & Mental Health T-score (population mean = 50; SD = 10)
scoring.mcidNote: ~3–5 T-score points MCID; population mean T=50
